description: Start a project: kind "ui" (apps, sites) or "marketing" (decks, pitch decks, posters, ads, posts, flyers, reports).

from_project.description: A project id from list_projects whose look this one starts from: its colours, fonts and named styles (for a deck or poster about an app). Nothing else is copied.

kind.description: "marketing" for any deck, pitch deck, presentation, poster, ad, social post, carousel, flyer, one-pager, brochure, report, certificate or invitation: its pages are designed here and export_document hands over the finished PDF, editable PowerPoint or post images. "ui" (default) for app screens and websites. Chosen once for the project.

planning.description: Required before the first project: the user's answers to the planning questions new_project lists (answers, in their words), where they chose to watch (watch: in_app_browser, own_browser or not_now), and assumed: true when they said to just go ahead. Without it new_project returns the questions and makes nothing.

name: new_project
title: New project
